security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* ws://127.0.0.1:*; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob: http://127.0.0.1:*; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'

bundle.longDescription: NeuralCut is a local-first AI-assisted video editor. It runs entirely on your machine: projects, media analysis, and the editing agent work offline without an NVIDIA GPU. Optional local/cloud model endpoints are never contacted unless you configure them.
